items.name: MvPolynomial.support_smul
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] {S₁ : Type u_2} [SMulZeroClass S₁ R] {a : S₁} {f : MvPolynomial σ R} : (a • f).support ⊆ f.support

items.name: MvPolynomial.support_smul_eq
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] {S : Type u_2} [Semiring S] [IsDomain S] [Module S R] [Module.IsTorsionFree S R] {a : S} (h : a ≠ 0) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : (a • p).support = p.support

items.name: MvPolynomial.support_expand
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [CommSemiring R] {p : ℕ} (φ : MvPolynomial σ R) [DecidableEq σ] (hp : p ≠ 0) : ((MvPolynomial.expand p) φ).support = Finset.image (fun x => p • x) φ.support

items.name: MvPolynomial.support_expand_subset
